symptoms.name: Irregular Appetite
symptoms.description: Fluctuating hunger patterns with unpredictable meal timings and variable digestive capacity

symptoms.name: Constipation
symptoms.description: Difficulty in bowel evacuation with hard, dry stool and irregular elimination

symptoms.name: Anxiety and Restlessness
symptoms.description: Mental agitation with excessive worry, inability to relax, and racing thoughts

symptoms.name: Dry Skin
symptoms.description: Skin lacking moisture with rough texture, flaking, and tendency toward cracking

symptoms.name: Insomnia
symptoms.description: Difficulty falling asleep or staying asleep with restless mind at night

symptoms.name: Acid Reflux
symptoms.description: Burning sensation in chest and throat with sour regurgitation after meals

symptoms.name: Skin Inflammation
symptoms.description: Red, inflamed skin with burning sensation, rashes, or acne

symptoms.name: Irritability
symptoms.description: Easy anger, frustration, and critical thinking with low tolerance

symptoms.name: Excessive Heat
symptoms.description: Feeling overheated easily with heat intolerance and preference for cool

symptoms.name: Burning Eyes
symptoms.description: Sensation of heat and burning in eyes with redness and sensitivity to light

symptoms.name: Weight Gain
symptoms.description: Tendency toward weight gain with slow metabolism and difficulty losing weight

symptoms.name: Congestion
symptoms.description: Mucus accumulation in sinuses, chest, or throat with heaviness

symptoms.name: Lethargy
symptoms.description: Physical and mental sluggishness with difficulty waking and low motivation

symptoms.name: Slow Digestion
symptoms.description: Sluggish digestive fire with prolonged feeling of fullness after meals

symptoms.name: Excessive Sleep
symptoms.description: Tendency toward oversleeping with difficulty waking and grogginess
